description: This class, RawConfigSupplier, provides logic for selecting and loading environment-specific configuration profiles for a service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It determines the appropriate configuration resource based on environment variables, falling back to default profiles if none are set, and composes the configuration with fallbacks.

classes.name: RawConfigSupplier
classes.description: An immutable supplier class that provides environment-aware configuration for a given service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of RawConfigSupplier with a specified service name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Loads and returns the configuration by applying environment-based fallbacks.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves environment-specific configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificBaseConfig
methods.description: Loads the base configuration resource for the specified service.
